title: Job
description: One open role. Ids for function, disciplines, level and metros come from taxonomy.yml; the schema checks their shape and tools/validate.py checks membership. jobs.json holds every role at a collected company; the publish step decides which functions and companies reach the board.

id.description: Stable across runs for the same posting. '{ats}:{board}:{posting_id}' when all three are known, otherwise 'web:' plus the first 12 hex digits of sha1 over the url, lower-cased title and lower-cased location text joined by newlines (some boards give every role the same address).

company_id.description: Id of a company in companies.yml.

url.description: The posting on the company's own board. Never an aggregator or search result.

board.description: The company's board token on that ATS.

read.description: auto: read from a feed. manual: read by a person. hosted: posted on HiPot by the employer.

locations.description: One entry per place the posting names. Structured fields are filled when the parser is confident.

function.description: The kind of work: one id from taxonomy.yml functions.

disciplines.description: Technical fields, most relevant first. Expected for engineering and science roles; optional for others.

level.description: From the title when it states one. Otherwise inferred from the years of experience the posting asks for (tagging.level_by 'years'; entry to principal only, never for an internship). Null when neither gives one.

experience_years.description: Years of experience the posting asks for: the largest required minimum it states (pipeline/tag/years.py). Absent when the posting states none.

basis.description: Where the figures came from. Only what the employer published; never an estimate.

posted_date.description: The date the feed reports as posted or last updated.

summary.description: Optional short plain-text excerpt of the posting.

tagging.description: Who or what set each tag, so a wrong tag can be traced.

level_by.description: rule: the title states the level. years: inferred from experience_years because the title states none. A title level always wins.

model.description: Model name when a model set any tag.

hosted.description: True for a role the employer posted on HiPot.
